name: Tom Benson
bio_short: Tom Benson is one of eight participants in Unframed at Holland Tunnel Revisited in Newburgh, a group that has met weekly for three years to paint outdoors together.
bio_long: Tom Benson took part in Unframed (September 12 to October 11, 2026) at Holland Tunnel Revisited, 46 Chambers Street, Newburgh. The exhibition brings together work by a group of people from different backgrounds who gather every week, in every season, to spend a few hours painting side by side. The paintings on view came out of those sessions over roughly three years. Benson exhibited alongside Paul Chidester, Emily Hopkins, Nancy Manter, Mitch Markowitz, Michelle Marozik, Kendall Munk and Itty Neuhaus. Further biographical details have not yet been confirmed and will be added once supplied by the artist or the gallery.
practice: Participates in a weekly group painting practice; works in the exhibition were made during these gatherings.
